verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents its own outbound webhooks. Alerts can route to "any HTTP endpoint via webhook", and automation rules can trigger webhooks, so a programmatic consumer can receive callbacks. The evidence covers only threshold alerts and automation rules, without a general event catalog or subscription API. Missing for 10: documented event types and payload schema, webhook registration via API, delivery guarantees (retries/signing), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Alerts can route to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any HTTP endpoint via webhook.
Automate workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations.
LangSmith provides threshold-based alerting on the following metrics: Run Count, Cost, Errors, Feedback Score, Latency
